# AlmaMesh

> AlmaMesh is a free, local-first Vedic astrology web app. Chart calculation runs in the browser, without an account or a server-side birth-data store.

## Product

- Computes sidereal charts, nakshatras, dashas, and divisional charts on the user's device.
- Available in 4 languages: English, Hindi (हिन्दी), Spanish (Español), and Portuguese (Português).
- Works offline after the engine and signed data bundle have been loaded.
- Offers optional AI narration configured by the user. Core chart calculation does not require AI.
- Presents astrology as reflective interpretation, with visible assumptions and uncertainty.
- Tests its readings against dated life events from a licensed research database. They do not pick the month of an event better than chance, so readings are offered for reflection: https://almamesh.com/how-we-test

## Privacy

Birth details and computed charts remain in the browser. The city search can use Open-Meteo with an offline fallback, and optional AI sends only user-approved context to the endpoint the user configures.

- Privacy: https://almamesh.com/privacy
- Data deletion: https://almamesh.com/data-deletion
- Terms: https://almamesh.com/terms
